name: What is trenchless sewer repair and how does it work?

mainEntity.name: What is trenchless sewer repair and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trenchless sewer repair is a method to fix damaged underground sewer lines without extensive digging. It typically involves two main techniques: pipe bursting or pipe lining. Pipe bursting replaces the old pipe by pulling a new one through, fracturing the old one in place. Pipe lining inserts a new epoxy-coated liner into the existing pipe, which then cures to form a new, seamless pipe. This approach significantly reduces disruption to your property and landscaping, a common concern for homeowners in areas like Summerlin where yards are often well-maintained.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trenchless sewer repair fixes underground sewer lines without digging, using methods like pipe bursting or pipe lining to repair or replace the damaged pipe.
